scope: Internal native execution-context review by the implementation agent; not an independent audit
finding: A detached Swift adapter task did not inherit cancellation of the owning WalletAuthorizer.handle task. Its context check could succeed after that request was cancelled.

reproduction.beforeFix: Cancellation case recorded one simulated broadcast instead of zero; close and normal completion cases also exercised

repair: An owning-request cancellation handler synchronously invalidates a lock-protected lifetime flag. Context validation checks the flag before and after the authorizer actor check; completion also invalidates it.
limits: Adapters must check the execution context after waits and before key use or submission. No check can retract an operation already dispatched.
